title: Lightly Roasted Ligurian Eggs Amatriciana Frittata
description: A roasted, crumbly, meal-prep Italian dish featuring eggs, beurre-monte, and a keto-friendly twist on the classic Amatriciana sauce. Made in a cedar plank vessel for added flavor and texture.
instructions: Line the cedar plank with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
In a large skillet, cook the pancetta over medium heat until crispy. Remove the pancetta from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the anchovies to the skillet and cook for an additional 30 seconds, until they dissolve into the garlic.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens and darkens in color.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and heavy cream. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the cooked pancetta, garlic, anchovies, and tomato paste to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the toppings in the skillet and smooth the top with a spatula.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, until the frittata is just set and the edges are golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
Allow the frittata to cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve warm.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
Reheat the frittata in the oven or microwave before serving.
